title: Short Stop Apt w/ Balcony Downtown Nashville
description:
Enjoy Fall in Music City from this stylish top-floor, downtown Nashville apartment with a gated garage and easy walk to Broadway! Enjoy 2 bedrooms/2 baths, a fully stocked kitchen, modern finishes, and an elevated, comfortable space close to restaurants, live music, and nightlife. Perfect for a Nashville getaway or extended stay. Special pricing available for insurance claims and temporary housing needs.

The space
Bliss Road Offers 5 Star Properties,
Fully Furnished with all Amenities,
High End Towels/Linens/ and Bedding.

The Short Stop Downtown is your Perfect Venue for Special Events! 🎉 

Whether you're planning a micro wedding, rehearsal dinner, or a special event - you just found your ideal venue. Nestled amidst picturesque surroundings, our charming Airbnb home offers a seamless blend of indoor elegance and outdoor beauty, ensuring a memorable experience for you and your guests. 

Every home has a starter kit stocked with paper products, including paper towels and toilet paper, as well as coffee supplies!

Guest access
Whole house designed to feel like a home away from home complete with all amenities! It is reserved for paid overnight guests only.

Other things to note
**Traveling with pets? We’re happy to welcome your furry friends! 

Please note there is a pet fee of $250 per pet, with a maximum of 2 pets per stay. This fee will be charged as your reservation is confirmed. 

Let us know in advance if you’ll be bringing a pet so we can ensure everything is ready for a comfortable stay, for both you and your companions! **

There is a strict no party policy, unless a gathering has been purchased and scheduled in advance with the host.  Only registered guests with overnight reservations are allowed to enter the house, unless a gathering has been booked with permissions in advance.

OPEN FOR: Temp Housing Agencies & Insurance Companies. Offering special rates for Insurance & Temp Housing Needs w/ Mid-Term Stays.
